overview: Namwala is a comprehensive bilingual (English/Swahili) agricultural platform for Tanzania, serving farmers, livestock keepers, buyers, specialists, veterinarians, input sellers, service providers, and transport providers. It provides AI-driven tools for disease detection, forecasting, irrigation management, live auctions, marketplace, messaging, payments, and community features.
features: Smart disease outbreak map with Tanzania regional alerts
Live auction system for crops and livestock
AI harvest and livestock production forecasting
Marketplace with map view and filters
AI advisor with voice input and spoken responses
Community forum with reputation and badges
Integrated mobile money payments with escrow
Transport provider search with booking and cost calculator
